text:
olivia: heads-up: python-sdk publish failed after the recent regen. CI failed fast on publish-check and changelog lint. logs show a typegen signature change and missing BREAKING CHANGES. snippet:
```
Typegen diff: sdk/python/redwood/api_client.py: def search(self, prefix: Optional[str]) -> ... -> def search(self, prefix: str) -> ...
lint:changelog: missing 'BREAKING CHANGES' section for semver-major bump
Publish check: version mismatch or missing release tag
```
max: who landed the openapi tweak? i saw a small validation tighten in PR #912 that made `prefix` required. intended?
olivia: it was part of an API quality fix. semver was set to minor in the PR metadata, which is wrong if it breaks SDKs.
dev-bot: [build 9482] FAILURE on release/python-sdk - typegen/regenerate + publish-check failed. details: https://ci.internal/redwood/9482 :x:
rachel: ok we have two immediate things: 1) decide semver (major) and add BREAKING entry, 2) either revert the openapi change or land coordinated SDK update + sample app migration. reverting is disruptive to product fix.
max: for onboarding UX i'd rather patch sample quickstart so new users don't hit a broken behavior. we can do a hotfix for sample apps and then do a major SDK release with migration notes.
olivia: i'll open a PR that: bumps python-sdk to 2.0.0, adds a BREAKING CHANGES section with migration snippet showing new callsite (explicit prefix string), commits the `yarn typegen --write` regen, and updates sample-app to handle required param. i'll tag @ops for manual publish.
ops: please also add a pre-publish check that verifies package version == git tag and that changelog contains BREAKING CHANGES when semver-major. created follow-up issue #1240.
max: small note: we should avoid committing manual edits into generated client. prefer generator config to keep pointer/optional semantics when we want compatibility. for python, maybe keep `Optional[str]` and validate server-side.
olivia: agreed. PR will include generator config tweak to prefer Optional for nullable string, but since openapi now marks required=true we still need major. making generator tolerant will ease transition later.
dev-bot: [build 9490] queued after push olivia:release/python-sdk-major - running regen + lint
